A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same Video2BEV work, with complete main text, references, and supplementary Sections 7–10. Text comparison and rendered-page inspection support reliable comparison of the equations, tables, figures, and appendices.

before.justification: v2 reports original retrieval experiments on UniV and SUES-200 in Table 2, component and training ablations in Table 3, and supplementary loss-weight experiments in Table 4.

after.justification: v3 retains the original UniV and SUES-200 experiments, ablations, and supplementary loss-weight results in Tables 2–4.

M1.justification: Sections 4.1–4.3 retain the same 3D Gaussian Splatting transformation, diffusion-based hard negatives, shared ViT-S encoder, losses, two-stage training, and inference procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same UniV coverage at 30° and 45° elevation angles and the same out-of-distribution evaluation on SUES-200's 45° test set. No dataset or task scenario is added or removed.

E2.justification: Figure 3 and Tables 2a–2b retain the same evaluated comparators: LPN, FSRA, DWDR, and Sample4Geo. Comparator membership is unchanged within each comparison.

E3.justification: The UniV split of 701 training and 951 test locations, Recall@1 and AP metrics, temporal score averaging, training settings, and top-32 reranking procedure are unchanged. Supplementary experimental settings also match.

E4.justification: Table 3 retains the component, training-strategy, and reranking-depth ablations; supplementary Table 4 retains the loss-weight analysis. Occlusion visualizations and the failure cases in Section 8 and Figure 12 are also unchanged.

E5.justification: Both versions report the same point estimates without repeated-run counts, seed information, confidence intervals, error bars, or significance tests. Uncertainty-reporting practices are unchanged.

E6.justification: Numerical results and qualitative examples match throughout. For example, Table 2 retains drone-to-satellite AP of 96.80 on UniV at 45° and 91.50 on SUES-200; the ablation results in Tables 3–4 also remain identical.

T1.justification: Equations 1–4 retain the same loss and similarity definitions, and supplementary Section 10 retains the same weighted-loss formulation. No mathematical assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: video-based drone localization, Video2BEV transformation, synthetic hard negatives, and UniV. Claims about retrieval performance and generalization are unchanged.

C2.justification: Both versions retain the explanations of viewpoint alignment, synthetic-negative benefits, and training-strategy behavior. Qualifications concerning low-elevation reconstruction and failures involving similar buildings, shadows, and color discrepancies are unchanged.

D1.justification: Implementation details in Sections 5 and 9, including hyperparameters, hardware, rendering time, and data processing, match. Both retain the statement that all data will be released upon acceptance.

R1.justification: The same 79 references and research-positioning passages are retained, including Section 2 and the comparison with GeNIe in Section 4.3. No cited work or novelty relationship changes.

P1.justification: v3 adds equal-contribution credit for Hao Ju and Shaofei Huang and changes Zhedong Zheng's corresponding-author symbol. The research prose, section order, and supplementary organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: v3 updates the first-page arXiv stamp and author-footnote notation. On page 4, the flight-regulation footnote markers disappear while the note remains, causing limited paragraph reflow. Figures and tables are unchanged; the other 12 pages render identically.

improvement.justification: v3 adds equal-contribution credit but removes the page-4 footnote markers while retaining the note. These small editorial changes leave the methods, empirical evidence, explanations, and supplementary material unchanged, with no meaningful net effect on overall paper quality.
